description: Write release notes from a public GitHub repository's commits and merged pull requests: since the last tag by default, between two tags (from/to), or between two dates (since/until). Breaking changes are marked and grouped. Returns Markdown or a Keep a Changelog section ready for CHANGELOG.md, plus a suggested next version. No AI, no sign-in.

format.description: "markdown" (release notes, the default) or "keep-a-changelog" (a CHANGELOG.md section).

from.description: Tag, branch or commit the notes start after (exclusive). Default: the tag before `to`.

repository.description: Public github.com repository: "owner/repo" or its URL. A release, tag or compare URL sets the range too.

since.description: Start date instead of a tag: YYYY-MM-DD (from the start of that day, UTC) or an ISO 8601 time with a time zone.

to.description: Tag, branch or commit the notes end at. Default: the default branch (unreleased changes). With dates, the branch to read.

until.description: End date, included: YYYY-MM-DD (to the end of that day, UTC) or an ISO 8601 time with a time zone. Default: now.

name: generate_release_notes
title: Release notes from a GitHub repo
